facts.title: Flagler roster reconciliation and material shared operating rules

assignment_review.circuit: G2025-042-FG effectiveSeptember29,2025 routes general civil and appellate/quasi-judicial review to49, probate/guardianship/incapacity/trust to48, family47, temporary juvenile tasks60 and enumerated protective matters61. Clerk routes ambiguity to court administration/chief.
assignment_review.administrative: Nichols appointed Flagler administrative judge October8,2025.
assignment_review.cross_assignments: G2026-029-SC(A) authorizes temporary cross assignments July1–December31,2026; does not establish every circuit judge as routine Flagler personnel.

rules.title: General civil filing assignment
rules.summary: General circuit civil cases not specifically allocated elsewhere and qualifying reviews go to Division49; trust/probate matters to48. See exceptions in original; assignment ambiguity routed by clerk to administration.

rules.title: Courthouse entrance screening
rules.summary: People and parcels screened unless court authorizes otherwise; dangerous items/refusal may result in denied entry. Security retains case-specific discretion. Official law-enforcement exceptions separately collected, not generalized to civil practitioners.

rules.title: ADA notice language
rules.summary: Notices/process compelling attendance must contain ExhibitA statement in bold14-point Bookman Old Style or Arial. Exhibit directs accommodation requests seven days ahead or immediately when shorter notice, to Bunnell ADA coordinator386-257-6096,ADARequest@circuit7.org;711 for hearing/voice impaired.

officer_screening.flagler_specific: Feliciano directory office saved separately; chief and administrative judge supported.
officer_screening.other_circuit_appointments: FM2026-004-SC(A) also appoints Alvarez,Kircher,Mensh circuit-wide. Saved directory places their offices in other counties; routine Flagler assignment not established. Keep source appointment evidence without duplicating them as Flagler-based officers.
officer_screening.senior_traffic: Bounded official-index and targeted-search screening did not identify a named currently routine Flagler senior/traffic officer. This is an explicit evidence gap, not a claim none exist.

review_scope.collected: Ten official HTML pages/indexes and one-page ADA exhibit with originals/metadata, plus previously saved roster and person evidence.
review_scope.content_reviewed: General index pages1–2 for material Flagler leads; relevant assignment/admin/access clauses, ADA notice and English contact text.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Jury-selection mechanics and law-enforcement weapon exceptions collected/screened only; other-county orders, criminal/diversion manuals and litigation-specific forms not expanded.

conflicts.statement: July2025 practice title says Circuit Civil; September2025 allocation routes general civil to49 and enumerated temporary matters to61. Both statements retained; no claim to resolve authority.
2026order/exhibit gives Bunnell/ADARequest/257-6096; older judge documents and grievance section have differing contacts. Sources retained with dates without controlling-authority determination.

gaps: Clerk departmental original HTML and property-appraiser destination blocked; indexed observations explicitly qualified.
Officer-specific Flagler assistant/email/procedures not established for Feliciano.
Routine Flagler assignment of other circuit-wide officers and named senior/traffic officer not established after bounded screening.
facts.next_action: Generate nine-person draft, audit each field against saved facts, test publication/historical isolation; county not yet accepted or published.
